'''The Hilltop''' was a structure on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in existence during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When looked at from above, it looked similar to the work of [[D.M. Skecher]].<ref name="SWG:PVT" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Located near the center of the Tatooine world map; this location, when viewed from above, looks similar to the work of D.M. Skecher.|In-game description of the Hilltop|<ref name="SWG:PVT" />}}
The Hilltop was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:PVT" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, players could complete a collection called "Panoramic Vistas." In this collection, players were given a clue as to how to find The Hilltop.<ref name="SWG:PVT" />
